rich_summary: As the armies of Kurukshetra stand ready to clash, Yudhishthira performs a startling act: he removes his armor, lays aside his weapons, and walks unarmed into the enemy ranks. His brothers are alarmed, but Krishna explains that the king intends to seek the blessings of his elders before fighting. Yudhishthira respectfully approaches Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, and Salya, asking permission to wage war without incurring sin and even inquiring how they might be defeated. Each elder admits he is bound to fight for the Kauravas because of obligations and wealth, yet blesses Yudhishthira and reveals hints about his own vulnerability. Krishna also tries to recruit Karna, who refuses out of loyalty to Duryodhana. Meanwhile, Yuyutsu defects to the Pandava side. Yudhishthira’s humility and adherence to dharma impress both armies, turning a moment before battle into a powerful moral statement.

top_scenes.scene_text: Yudhishthira removes his armor and walks unarmed across the battlefield between two vast armies while warriors watch in stunned silence.
Yudhishthira bows at Bhishma’s feet amid the battlefield while the aged grandsire blesses him despite standing on the opposing side.
Yuyutsu leaves the Kaurava ranks and crosses over to the Pandava army as drums and conches resound across the field.
